interface.name: zopenlook_workspaces_manager_v1
interface.description:
This protocol lets an unprivileged client (olshell) query and change which OpenLook workspace is active, and learn which workspace a given toplevel belongs to.
olcore intentionally keeps no OpenLook-specific policy beyond tracking a linear sequence of workspaces and, for each mapped toplevel (as identified via wlr-foreign-toplevel-management), which workspace it belongs to. All workspace UI -- switcher strip, naming, animations -- is olshell's responsibility; this protocol only carries the facts olshell needs to draw it.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by bumping the major version number in the protocol and interface names.

request.name: switch_to
request.description: Requests that the compositor make the workspace at the given index the active one. index must be less than the count most recently sent in a workspace_count event; out-of-range values are ignored.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this manager object. Does not affect workspace state.

event.name: workspace_count
event.description: Sent once immediately after binding, and again whenever the number of workspaces changes.

event.name: active_changed
event.description: Sent once immediately after binding, and again whenever the active workspace changes, regardless of what caused the change (this client's own switch_to request, another client's, or a compositor-bound keybinding).

event.name: toplevel_workspace
event.description: Sent whenever a toplevel is assigned to, or reassigned to, a workspace. toplevel is a handle from wlr-foreign-toplevel-management-unstable-v1, letting olshell correlate this assignment with the toplevel metadata (title, app_id, ...) that protocol already provides.

arg.name: index
arg.summary: workspace index the toplevel now belongs to
